items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I played with Jack Carroll for quite a while

ctx.x: Oh yeah, that picture of the Gibson or the Jackson, I don't remember which it was. No, I never showed you the Liberty Bell.

I played with them. I played with them. I didn't play with them regularly, but the most I was playing with my brother, we had the Young Tuxedo. We was running this town. Wasn't none of them bands hardly could do anything with us. We had a good band. We used to play at Vicki Adams in the town of the Pawn Garden was open there, Aiden Rampo. We used to play there one time. Then we used to play for the Bulls. I played with Jack Carroll for quite a while and I played with Chris Kelly about six years. I played with…
Let's start back at the beginning. That might make it come out in better order, you know? So what was your very first instrument you played? Drums.

items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: I played Sam Moore, you know, just a little job. Buddy Pete, Joe Alva, Jack Carey.

ctx.x: I played Sam Moore, you know, just a little job. Buddy Pete, Joe Alva, Jack Carey. Uh-huh. I played a lot of music. Yeah, I imagine.
Been a long while playing too.
